name: JETNET AI
summary: Natural-language assistant over JETNET's business aircraft data on fleet, ownership, transactions and utilization, now available inside Teams and Slack via MCP.
paragraphs: Natural-language assistant over JETNET's business aircraft data on fleet, ownership, transactions and utilization, now available inside Teams and Slack via MCP.
whyItMatters: Brokers, dealers and MRO sales teams can ask who owns which aircraft and what is trading without building reports by hand.
